title: Network
description: Where Plinthio can be used from, and two-factor away from home.

device.address: Address {ip}. To check outside access, open this page on a phone using mobile data (Wi-Fi off). It should say "outside".

tailscale.setUpAt: Set up at {address}, not used since Plinthio last started. Open it from a Tailscale device to check.
tailscale.notSetUp: Not set up, as far as Plinthio can tell. Tailscale gives you a trusted {address} address at home and away; with Funnel, it's also a link anyone can open, with no domain. Open the guide to set it up.
tailscale.funnelWorking: Funnel is working: a visitor from the internet, {time}.
tailscale.funnelNeedsAccess: Funnel visitors come from the internet, and outside access is off, so they'll see "available at home only".

proxy.title: A proxy is in front of Plinthio, but TRUST_PROXY isn't set
proxy.text: Every visitor looks like they come from the proxy ({from}), usually a home address, so outside access can't be told apart. The Tailscale and public-address add-ons set it for you. For another proxy, see docs/remote-access.md.

adminsWithout2fa.text: The server is open to the internet. Turning on two-factor for admins (Settings → Security) is strongly recommended.

remoteAccess.title: Allow access from outside the home network
remoteAccess.text: Off: only devices at home (and on Tailscale, below) can sign in or use anything; the internet gets "available at home only". On: anyone with an account allowed away from home can sign in from anywhere. This only decides who's let in: reaching the server from the internet also needs Tailscale Funnel (no domain needed) or a web address (the public-address add-on).

tailscaleIsHome.title: Tailscale devices count as home
tailscaleIsHome.text: On (the default): anything on your tailnet is treated like your home network. Turn off if you share the server with Tailscale users you'd rather treat as outside.

require2fa.title: Require two-factor away from home
require2fa.text: Optional. Sign-ins from outside need a code from a phone app. At home a password is still enough, so anyone without two-factor can sign in there and set it up (Settings → Security).
require2fa.onlyWhenOn: Only applies when outside access is on.

accounts.hint: Set who may use Plinthio away from home, and reset someone's two-factor, in the Users tab.

docsHint: How to reach Plinthio from outside (Tailscale, or a web address for guests), step by step: {link}, or {file} on GitHub.

confirm.title: Allow access from outside?
confirm.message: Anyone with an account (that's allowed away from home) will be able to sign in from the internet, once the server has a web address. Use strong passwords, and consider requiring two-factor away from home.

guide.private: Private: my devices and people I add
guide.funnel: Also a link for friends without Tailscale (Funnel)
guide.privateText: Plinthio gets {address}, trusted on every device signed in to your Tailscale. Nothing is opened to the internet.
guide.funnelText: The same address also opens in anyone's browser, with no Tailscale, domain or router changes. Tailscale limits Funnel's bandwidth: reading and listening are fine, video may buffer.

dns.title: Turn on MagicDNS and HTTPS Certificates
dns.text: On the DNS page of the admin console. Both are switches.

key.title: Make an auth key
key.text: Settings → Keys → Generate auth key. Keep the page open; you'll paste it in the next step. (Optional: without one, the server prints a sign-in link instead.)

funnelStep.title: Let the internet in
funnelStep.text: Funnel visitors come from the internet, so Plinthio needs {outsideAccess} on ({where}). Consider requiring two-factor away from home too. The first time, Tailscale may ask you to allow Funnel for your tailnet: if {command} says so, follow its link or allow it under Access controls.
funnelStep.whereSetup: this setup step does that for you

devices.title: Install Tailscale on your phones and computers
devices.funnelTitle: Try it, and send friends the link
devices.text: Sign in with the same account, then open {address} (the admin console lists the exact address under Machines) and add it to your home screen from there.
devices.funnelText: On a phone with Wi-Fi off and Tailscale not running, open the address. You should get the sign-in page. Then make your friends accounts (Admin → Users) and send them the link.
